title: Cyber Risk Propagation and Optimal Selection of Cybersecurity Controls for Complex Cyberphysical Systems
summary: Proposes novel methods for analyzing cyber risk propagation and aggregation in complex interconnected CPS using graph-based modeling, and employs genetic algorithms to automate optimal selection of cybersecurity controls from NIST guidelines. Applied to autonomous and remotely controlled ships (Cyber-Enabled Ships) using STRIDE/DREAD threat modeling.

title: Risk Assessment and Control Selection for Cyber-Physical Systems: A Case Study on Supply Chain Tracking Systems
source: Journal of Surveillance, Security and Safety
summary: Combines and extends two CPS risk assessment methodologies into comprehensive framework integrating IoT-enabled attack path assessment with risk propagation and optimal control selection. Utilizes CVE/CPE/CVSS for vulnerability assessment, STRIDE/DREAD for threat and risk analysis, and genetic algorithms for control optimization. Applied to supply chain tracking systems with validation using cascading control selection across all STRIDE threats.

title: Enterprise Security Risk Management #4: Analysis of Security Risk Management - New Thinking
summary: Comprehensive synthesis of enterprise security risk management concepts integrating systems thinking, complexity theory, and critical infrastructure protection. Covers security as business function vs policing, food security and supply chains, protective security as enduring process, intelligence-led risk management, and professional security management. Synthesizes perspectives from Smith & Brooks, Gill, Wakefield, Tooma, and multiple government sources (US DOE, Australian Critical Infrastructure Centre) with emphasis on dynamic, adaptive security approaches.
